functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.auto_resolve_content_error_flags()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_content_type text := TG_ARGV[0];  -- 'note' or 'flashcard'
BEGIN
  UPDATE content_flags
  SET
    status          = 'resolved',
    resolved_by     = NULL,
    resolution_note = 'Content updated by creator',
    resolved_at     = now()
  WHERE content_id  = NEW.id
    AND content_type = v_content_type
    AND reason       = 'content_error'
    AND status       = 'pending';

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_badge_check_new_profile()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- Ensure user_stats row exists for new user (defensive; counter triggers also upsert)
  INSERT INTO user_stats (user_id)
  VALUES (NEW.id)
  ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO NOTHING;

  -- Pioneer: registered before March 1, 2026
  IF NEW.created_at < '2026-03-01 00:00:00+00'::TIMESTAMPTZ THEN
    PERFORM award_badge(NEW.id, 'pioneer');
  END IF;

  RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_cleanup_orphan_batch_provenance()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- Ordinary updates (no batch_id actually changed) return immediately.
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM old_rows o JOIN new_rows n ON n.id = o.id
                  WHERE o.batch_id IS DISTINCT FROM n.batch_id) THEN
    RETURN NULL;
  END IF;

  -- One batch-level pass: source batches that lost cards and now have zero cards left.
  DELETE FROM public.flashcard_batch_provenance p
   WHERE p.batch_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT o.batch_id
                          FROM old_rows o JOIN new_rows n ON n.id = o.id
                         WHERE o.batch_id IS NOT NULL
                           AND o.batch_id IS DISTINCT FROM n.batch_id)
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.flashcards f WHERE f.batch_id = p.batch_id);

  RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

functions.name: fn_course_change_archive_restore
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_course_change_archive_restore()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.role IS DISTINCT FROM 'student' THEN
    RETURN NULL;
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.my_cards_enrollment e
     SET status = 'course_archived',
         archived_course = a.card_course,
         archived_at = now()
    FROM public.course_change_affected(NEW.id, OLD.course_level, NEW.course_level) a
   WHERE e.id = a.enrollment_id AND a.action = 'archive';

  UPDATE public.my_cards_enrollment e
     SET status = 'active',
         archived_course = NULL,
         archived_at = NULL
    FROM public.course_change_affected(NEW.id, OLD.course_level, NEW.course_level) a
   WHERE e.id = a.enrollment_id AND a.action = 'restore';

  RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

functions.name: fn_create_profile_on_signup
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_create_profile_on_signup()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.profiles (
    id,
    email,
    full_name,
    course_level,
    institution,
    role,
    account_type,
    timezone,
    created_at
  )
  VALUES (
    NEW.id,
    lower(btrim(NEW.email)),
    COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', ''),
    NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'course_level',
    'In-house',
    'student',
    'self_registered',
    'Asia/Kolkata',
    NOW()
  )
  ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_require_note_provenance()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.content_source_type IS NULL
     OR NEW.content_source_name IS NULL
     OR btrim(NEW.content_source_name) = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'content_source_type and content_source_name are required on note creation';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_update_flashcards_counter()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
    INSERT INTO user_stats (user_id, total_flashcards, updated_at)
    VALUES (NEW.user_id, 1, NOW())
    ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
      SET total_flashcards = user_stats.total_flashcards + 1,
          updated_at        = NOW();

  ELSIF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    UPDATE user_stats
    SET total_flashcards = GREATEST(0, total_flashcards - 1),
        updated_at        = NOW()
    WHERE user_id = OLD.user_id;
  END IF;

  RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

functions.name: fn_update_friendships_counter
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_update_friendships_counter()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN

    -- Friendship accepted
    IF NEW.status = 'accepted' AND OLD.status != 'accepted' THEN
      INSERT INTO user_stats (user_id, total_friends, updated_at)
      VALUES (NEW.user_id, 1, NOW())
      ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
        SET total_friends = user_stats.total_friends + 1,
            updated_at    = NOW();

      INSERT INTO user_stats (user_id, total_friends, updated_at)
      VALUES (NEW.friend_id, 1, NOW())
      ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
        SET total_friends = user_stats.total_friends + 1,
            updated_at    = NOW();
    END IF;

    -- Friendship un-accepted (e.g. status reverted to pending/rejected)
    IF NEW.status != 'accepted' AND OLD.status = 'accepted' THEN
      UPDATE user_stats
      SET total_friends = GREATEST(0, total_friends - 1),
          updated_at    = NOW()
      WHERE user_id = NEW.user_id;

      UPDATE user_stats
      SET total_friends = GREATEST(0, total_friends - 1),
          updated_at    = NOW()
      WHERE user_id = NEW.friend_id;
    END IF;

  ELSIF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN

    -- Accepted friendship deleted (unfriended)
    IF OLD.status = 'accepted' THEN
      UPDATE user_stats
      SET total_friends = GREATEST(0, total_friends - 1),
          updated_at    = NOW()
      WHERE user_id = OLD.user_id;

      UPDATE user_stats
      SET total_friends = GREATEST(0, total_friends - 1),
          updated_at    = NOW()
      WHERE user_id = OLD.friend_id;
    END IF;

  END IF;

  RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notify_badge_earned()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_badge_name TEXT;
BEGIN
    -- Get badge name for the message
    SELECT name INTO v_badge_name
    FROM badge_definitions
    WHERE id = NEW.badge_id;

    -- Create notification
    PERFORM create_notification(
        p_user_id := NEW.user_id,
        p_type := 'badge_earned',
        p_actor_id := NULL,                 -- System notification, no actor
        p_target_type := 'badge',
        p_target_id := NEW.badge_id,
        p_message := 'You earned the "' || COALESCE(v_badge_name, 'Achievement') || '" badge!'
    );

    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

functions.name: update_deck_card_count
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_deck_card_count()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
    UPDATE flashcard_decks
    SET card_count = card_count + 1,
        visibility = CASE
          WHEN (CASE visibility     WHEN 'public' THEN 2 WHEN 'friends' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
             < (CASE NEW.visibility WHEN 'public' THEN 2 WHEN 'friends' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
          THEN NEW.visibility
          ELSE visibility
        END
    WHERE user_id = NEW.user_id
      AND (subject_id     IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.subject_id)
      AND (topic_id       IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.topic_id)
      AND (custom_subject IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.custom_subject)
      AND (custom_topic   IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.custom_topic);

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
      INSERT INTO flashcard_decks (
        user_id, subject_id, topic_id,
        custom_subject, custom_topic,
        target_course, visibility, card_count
      ) VALUES (
        NEW.user_id, NEW.subject_id, NEW.topic_id,
        NEW.custom_subject, NEW.custom_topic,
        NEW.target_course, NEW.visibility, 1
      );
    END IF;

  ELSIF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    UPDATE flashcard_decks
    SET card_count = GREATEST(card_count - 1, 0)
    WHERE user_id = OLD.user_id
      AND (subject_id     IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.subject_id)
      AND (topic_id       IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.topic_id)
      AND (custom_subject IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.custom_subject)
      AND (custom_topic   IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.custom_topic);

    -- Auto-delete deck when it becomes empty
    DELETE FROM flashcard_decks
    WHERE user_id = OLD.user_id
      AND (subject_id     IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.subject_id)
      AND (topic_id       IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.topic_id)
      AND (custom_subject IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.custom_subject)
      AND (custom_topic   IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.custom_topic)
      AND card_count = 0;

  END IF;

  RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$
